title: Beaver Ke Orange Daant Ka Sach! 🦫 #shorts
idea: Beavers have orange teeth due to iron compounds and can hold their breath for up to 15 minutes.

lines.text: Kya aapko pata hai Beaver ke daant asli mein orange hote hain?
Ye koi gandagi nahi, inke daant iron ki vajah se orange hain!
Inhi majboot daaton se Beaver 50 minute mein ped kaat sakta hai!
Paani mein ye poore 15 minute tak saans rok sakta hai!
Bahar aate hi ye 75 percent lungs air ek saath badal leta hai!
Jabki insaan sirf 15 percent! Kya aapne kabhi Beaver dekha hai?

facts.claim: Beaver's incisors are colored orange by iron compounds.
Beavers can cut down trees up to 15 cm wide in less than 50 minutes.
Beavers can hold their breath for up to 15 minutes.
Beavers replace 75% of air in lungs in one breath compared to 15% for humans.
